subject.title: [Feature Request] Add streamTo="parent" support for runtime="subagent"

question: Should native subagent progress be exposed to the parent session, and what redaction, verbosity, and routing contract must govern it?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally keep native subagents completion-only, and exposing live child progress crosses session, channel, and potentially sensitive tool-output boundaries.

options.title: Design opt-in native relay
options.body: Add native `streamTo: "parent"` only after defining redaction, truncation, verbosity inheritance, routing, cleanup, and tests for both quiet and verbose paths.

options.title: Keep ACP-only streaming
options.body: Leave native subagents completion-only and document ACP as the supported live-progress runtime for now.

options.title: Split minimal wait indicator
options.body: Implement only a safe parent waiting/progress heartbeat first, and track full child tool/output streaming as a separate security-reviewed feature.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in native relay
recommendation.body: Add native `streamTo: "parent"` only after defining redaction, truncation, verbosity inheritance, routing, cleanup, and tests for both quiet and verbose paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing ACP parent-stream relay history makes this the closest implementation and policy comparison point.
